scope.context: ordinary human singleplayer; clan-specific cards have narrower guards
scope.kind: curated conversion facts and conditional mechanism cards, not an executable complete economy or recommendation engine

semantics.time_unit: game_seconds; pauses contribute zero elapsed production, growth or labor time
semantics.cost_vector: positive quantities are resources required; omitted keys in a known vector mean absent from that particular vector, not zero total investment
semantics.null: not established or not modeled, never an implied zero
semantics.empty_cost_vector: known zero resource charge only in an explicitly identified branch; facilities, labor, prerequisites and time remain separate
semantics.base_cost: installed configuration or ordinary constant vector before current-state price branches
semantics.conditional_quote: code-derived result under listed guards, not an observed native UI quote
semantics.observed_quote: complete quote actually observed at a specified game state; none is supplied by this catalog
semantics.observed_payment: payment actually linked to the operation and reconciled separately from continuous flows; none is supplied by this catalog
semantics.completion: payment, project creation, completion, staffing, eligibility, aggregate-rate update and stock credit are different milestones
semantics.labor: assigned headcount, effective production and native individual settlement are different quantities
semantics.comparison: retain resource and capability vectors plus deadlines; no permanent cross-resource exchange rate or unconditional best action

population_food.summary: Housing population and stored population differ. Ordinary food consumption has a population-size term and separately weighted eligible units; the homogeneous simplification requires their weight sum to equal P.

production.summary: Eligibility, dynamic base, bonuses/maluses, aggregate cache and settlement are separate. No persistent per-unit final-income table was established in inspected objects; getters are not executed.

construction.summary: startBuilding #4957 gets a state-dependent cost and calls useResources before building creation. Construction progress and effective production are later stages; full scheduler, cancel/refund and worker-count timing are not modeled.

colonization.summary: Payment resource legality, price, start/payment, ownership completion and cancellation require separate evidence. Raven Money colonization is a clan-specific legal path, not a universal Food/Money exchange.

recruitment.kind: installed configuration and selected code anchors rechecked offline 2026-10-27
recruitment.summary: The installed base vectors are hero 150 Money/5 Iron and Kaija 40 Food/40 Money. getWarchiefCost #5022 has free/recruit/death and other dynamic branches; hireHero #5031 checks legality, pays via useResources, then spawns. A base vector is not a paid receipt.

building_upgrades.kind: installed configuration and price source rechecked offline 2026-10-27
building_upgrades.summary: TownHall base upgrade is 100 Wood/50 Money/10 Stone; ScoutCamp base upgrade is 50 Wood/50 Money/5 Stone. getUpgradeCost #5818 reads the selected upgrade cost and then has current-state modifications, including Upgrades knowledge. Full price and finish-time models are not supplied.

forge.kind: installed constants and selected code anchors rechecked offline 2026-10-27
forge.summary: Ordinary constants form weapon 5 Iron/50 Money and relic 10 Iron/100 Money/50 Wood vectors. Effective ShieldMaster can return an empty ShieldBearer weapon resource vector. Forge projects and their time path still exist. Relic and weapon price getters retain dynamic branches; special forge modes are excluded.

bear_capabilities.summary: Bear fishing/food and recovery require the inspected non-sea Shoal and ability/zone conditions. 200-fame local production sources are alternatives, not repeated stacks. Kaija enemy-territory passage and relic hero effects have separate guards.

growth.summary: Ordinary Bear/Raven singleplayer FreeForAll uses sqrt(H)*complete growthBonus for H>0 and the inspected threshold 55+5P. TownHall progress, stored resource-component growth, threshold crossing and actual birth are different; complete bonus and birth gating remain incomplete.

mining.summary: Miners contribute to shared deposit progress; crossing extraction conditions gives discrete resource credit. The full carry/leave/depletion and multi-miner boundary is not live-validated.

knowledge.summary: Knowledge has prerequisites, category/mode-dependent costs and alternate acquisition/effective providers. A researched scalar entry, a legal current purchase, a fame reward and effective hasTech are not interchangeable.
